name: tracker-offline-bun-codes
goal: A spoke on the shipped Bun runtime treats refused, unresolved and unroutable hubs as an outage

evidence: On the shipped Bun 1.2.18 binary a refused or unresolved hub throws code ConnectionRefused (no route: FailedToOpenSocket). Expected: the due owner starts. Observed: held. Reproduced with BUN_BE_BUN=1 on release 44dd318dc4 running test/support/trackerHubOutageProbe.ts at a88a90293d source: refused=false, unresolved=false.

tracker-offline-due.test.ts served real outages but vitest runs on Node, whose fetch codes differ from Bun's, and it had no DNS case. It now also runs the real transport and permit code under the bun on PATH (CI pins 1.2.18), with DNS and refusal cases.
